caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with two main sections stacked vertically. The upper section features two doors with a glass surface divided into multiple geometric panes by wooden bars forming diamond and rectangular shapes. The glass appears translucent with a greenish tint visible behind the woodwork. The lower section comprises two drawers at the top, each with a small round knob, and below these drawers, there are two solid wooden doors with simple panels and another set of knobs. The wood tone is a rich reddish-brown, with visible grain patterns and shading that indicates dimension and light reflection. The cabinet has a flat base with a modestly curved apron and a protruding, molded cornice at the top. The background is a plain, light beige with some darker shading around the edges. There is a faint handwritten inscription in the lower right corner.
title: Cupboard
